visible_card.passage: In film photography, a contact sheet places small positive images from many negatives onto one sheet of photographic paper. It lets a photographer review an entire roll at once, compare neighboring frames, mark promising images, and decide which negatives deserve larger prints. A frame that seems strong by itself can look repetitive, transitional, or unusually distinctive when it is seen beside the surrounding sequence.
